text: A Californian who is 17 on primary day but will turn 18 by the November general election can vote in that primary.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Voter ID & Registration Requirements
truthSource.oneLine: To register and vote in California you must be 18 or older on Election Day; 16- and 17-year-olds can only pre-register.

lesson.tip: Prop 18 (2020) would have allowed this, and other states have similar rules, so it sounds familiar. California voters rejected it, 56% to 44%. When a rule sounds familiar, check whether it actually passed in your state.
